name: porkbun-mcp
description: Register and manage domains, DNS, DNSSEC, SSL, email forwarding, the marketplace, static hosting, and webhooks through the official Porkbun API.
long_description:
The official Porkbun MCP server exposes the Porkbun v3 API as native tools for AI agents. Register, renew, and transfer domains; manage DNS and DNSSEC records; retrieve SSL bundles; configure nameservers, glue, URL forwarding, and domain contacts; provision and deploy Secure Static Hosting; and subscribe to signed webhooks — all from your assistant.

Built for autonomous use: write tools attach an Idempotency-Key so retries never double-charge, and per-key domain/IP allowlists let you scope a key to exactly what an agent should touch. The documentation-search and mock tools work with no credentials, and you can mint a free, isolated **sandbox** key to rehearse the full lifecycle without spending money or touching a real registry.

api_key.title: Porkbun API Key
api_key.description: Your Porkbun API key (starts with pk1_). Optional — the documentation, mock, and sandbox-key tools work without it; add it to manage real domains. Create one at https://porkbun.com/account/api.

secret_api_key.title: Porkbun Secret API Key
secret_api_key.description: Your Porkbun secret API key (starts with sk1_). Required together with the API key for authenticated operations.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Verify the Porkbun API connection and credentials.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check whether a single domain is available for registration and what it costs.

tools.name: get_registration_requirements
tools.description: Get a TLD's registration requirements as JSON Schema.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get current Porkbun pricing for all supported TLDs.

tools.name: list_marketplace
tools.description: Browse domains for sale on the Porkbun marketplace (aftermarket — domains owned by other users, not new registrations).

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains in the authenticated Porkbun account.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get the metadata for a single domain in the authenticated account: status, TLD, create date, expire date, security lock, WHOIS privacy, auto-renew, API access opt-in, and (optionally) labels.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the available account credit balance for the authenticated Porkbun account.

tools.name: get_api_settings
tools.description: Get the authenticated account's API spend control configuration: monthly spend limit, low-balance alert threshold, auto top-up settings, and current month's API spend total.

tools.name: get_nameservers
tools.description: Get the current nameservers configured for a domain in the authenticated account.

tools.name: list_dns_records
tools.description: List all DNS records for a domain in the authenticated account.

tools.name: list_dnssec_records
tools.description: List the DNSSEC DS records currently submitted to the registry for a domain.

tools.name: list_url_forwards
tools.description: List all URL forwarding rules configured for a domain.

tools.name: list_glue_records
tools.description: List glue records for a domain.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: List all in-progress and recent inbound domain transfers for the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_transfer_status
tools.description: Get the status of a specific inbound transfer for a domain.

tools.name: get_ssl_bundle
tools.description: Retrieve the free Porkbun-issued SSL certificate bundle for a domain.

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.description: Get the four contacts (registrant, admin, tech, billing) for a domain in the authenticated account, with their current field values (name, organization, address, phone, email).

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: **Spends account credit.** Registers a new domain on the authenticated Porkbun account.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: **Spends account credit.** Renews an existing domain in the authenticated account.

tools.name: transfer_domain
tools.description: **Spends account credit.** Initiates a transfer of an external domain into Porkbun.

tools.name: update_auto_renew
tools.description: Turn auto-renewal on or off for a domain in the authenticated account.

tools.name: update_nameservers
tools.description: Replace the nameservers for a domain in the authenticated account.

tools.name: update_contacts
tools.description: Edit a domain's contacts.

tools.name: list_hosting_plans
tools.description: List the hosting plans provisionable via the API, with price (cents — pass as `acknowledged_cost` to create_hosting), interval, trial length, and features.

tools.name: create_hosting
tools.description: Provision hosting for a domain in the account — Secure Static Hosting OR Cloud for WordPress (a managed WordPress site), chosen by `sku`.

tools.name: get_hosting
tools.description: Get Secure Static Hosting status for a domain (plan, server, trial, expiry, auto-renew), or null if the domain has no hosting.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Upload static files to a domain's Secure Static Hosting.

tools.name: list_hosting_files
tools.description: List file/directory names under an optional `path` in a domain's Secure Static Hosting space.

tools.name: delete_hosting_file
tools.description: Delete a file (or empty directory) at `path` in a domain's Secure Static Hosting space.

tools.name: make_hosting_dir
tools.description: Create a directory (and any missing parent directories) at `path` in a domain's Secure Static Hosting space.

tools.name: create_wp_credentials
tools.description: CLOUD FOR WORDPRESS ONLY.

tools.name: list_wp_credentials
tools.description: CLOUD FOR WORDPRESS ONLY.

tools.name: delete_wp_credentials
tools.description: CLOUD FOR WORDPRESS ONLY.

tools.name: delete_hosting
tools.description: Deprovision (cancel) Secure Static Hosting for a domain; teardown is scheduled by Porkbun.

tools.name: create_sandbox_key
tools.description: Instantly create a free SANDBOX API key — NO credentials or approval needed (works before you have any keys).

tools.name: sandbox_topup
tools.description: SANDBOX ONLY.

tools.name: sandbox_reset
tools.description: SANDBOX ONLY.

tools.name: sandbox_trigger_webhook
tools.description: SANDBOX ONLY.

tools.name: mock_call
tools.description: Get a schema-accurate EXAMPLE response for any API endpoint with NO credentials — nothing to set up.

tools.name: create_dns_record
tools.description: Create a DNS record on a domain in the authenticated account.

tools.name: update_dns_record
tools.description: Update an existing DNS record by its numeric `record_id` (obtained from `list_dns_records`).

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete a single DNS record by its numeric `record_id` (obtained from `list_dns_records`).

tools.name: create_dnssec_record
tools.description: Submit a DNSSEC DS record to the registry for a domain.

tools.name: delete_dnssec_record
tools.description: Remove a DNSSEC DS record from the registry for a domain, identified by key tag.

tools.name: create_url_forward
tools.description: Add a URL forwarding rule for a domain.

tools.name: delete_url_forward
tools.description: Delete a URL forwarding rule by its `id` (obtained from `list_url_forwards`).

tools.name: create_glue_record
tools.description: Create a glue record for a host on a domain.

tools.name: update_glue_record
tools.description: Update the IP addresses associated with an existing glue record.

tools.name: delete_glue_record
tools.description: Delete a glue record by host on a domain.

tools.name: list_doc_topics
tools.description: List the available Porkbun API documentation topics.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read a Porkbun documentation page as Markdown.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword-search the full Porkbun API reference and return the most relevant sections (endpoints/topics) as Markdown.

tools.name: get_webhook_event_types
tools.description: List the event types you can subscribe a webhook endpoint to.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints registered on the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook endpoint by its numeric id, including its signing secret and delivery health (consecutive failures, last success/failure).

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List recent webhook delivery attempts (newest first), across all endpoints or filtered to one.

tools.name: get_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook delivery by id, including the full JSON payload that was (or will be) sent and its delivery status.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Generate a new signing secret for a webhook endpoint and return the endpoint with the new secret.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a `webhook.test` event to an endpoint to confirm it's reachable and that signature verification works.

tools.name: resend_webhook
tools.description: Re-queue a past webhook delivery to its endpoint.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint by id.

tools.name: get_cloudflare_connection
tools.description: Check whether this Porkbun account is connected to a Cloudflare account, and which one.

tools.name: list_cloudflare_inventory
tools.description: List every domain in the account with its Cloudflare eligibility: `state` is eligible / warn / blocked / connected / inprogress, each with a human-readable reason (DNSSEC live, custom nameservers, uses Porkbun hosting, etc).

tools.name: connect_domains_to_cloudflare
tools.description: Queue domains to move into the customer's own Cloudflare account: Porkbun creates the zone there, copies over the DNS records it holds, and repoints the registry nameservers at Cloudflare.

tools.name: get_cloudflare_queue
tools.description: List every Cloudflare move this account has requested, with per-domain status and message.

tools.name: get_cloudflare_domain_status
tools.description: Get the Cloudflare move status for ONE domain, including the Cloudflare zone id once created and the nameservers Porkbun replaced (kept so the move can be undone).

tools.name: retry_cloudflare_domain
tools.description: Re-queue a domain whose Cloudflare move failed or was skipped.

tools.name: rollback_cloudflare_domain
tools.description: UNDO a completed Cloudflare move: point the domain's nameservers back at Porkbun, restoring the DNS Porkbun still holds.

tools.name: disconnect_cloudflare
tools.description: Remove this account's stored Cloudflare connection.

tools.name: get_cloudflare_records
tools.description: List a domain's LIVE DNS records as Cloudflare holds them, each with its orange-cloud (`proxied`) state and whether it is `proxiable` at all.

tools.name: set_cloudflare_proxy
tools.description: Turn the Cloudflare proxy (orange cloud) on or off for a domain's DNS records.

tools.name: preview_cloudflare_move
tools.description: Show exactly which DNS records would be copied into Cloudflare for a domain, and which would be dropped, WITHOUT queueing anything.

tools.name: get_cloudflare_zone
tools.description: Get what CLOUDFLARE currently says about a domain's zone (status, paused, its nameservers, activation date) rather than what Porkbun's queue row remembers.

tools.name: get_cloudflare_zone_settings
tools.description: Read the Cloudflare zone settings that matter after a move: ssl mode, always_use_https, automatic_https_rewrites, min_tls_version, development_mode, cache_level.

tools.name: set_cloudflare_zone_settings
tools.description: Change Cloudflare zone settings for a moved domain.
